name: Allcargo Logistics Limited
about: Allcargo Logistics Limited provides integrated logistics solutions in India. It offers express logistics comprising ground and air express, and retail services; consultive logistics, including warehousing and storage, transportation management, in-plant management, stores and line feed, distribution and inbound logistics, and ecommerce order fulfillment. The company also offers express distribution, air freight, e-commerce logistics, and first and last mile delivery; B2C services, such as laabh, bike express, and student express solutions. Allcargo Logistics Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
